Description:
tables_path
Help:
What method of mortality improvement to apply
to the experience mortality basis:
1) None - no improvement, use base table as
is.
2) Table - Table of mortality mutipliers by
projection year (CMIR10 mortality improvement
factors).
3) Constant - constant improvement factors
over time, varying by age and sex (suitable for
old Israeli regulations with 0.5% for all age and
sex)
4) Changing - changing improvement factors
over time, changing based on alpha and ___,
base factors varying by age and sex (suitable
for new Israeli regulations)

Description:
Calendar year in period t
Help:
The actual calendar year we are presently in at
time period t.
Note on New Business Layering:
When performing a run, new business always
incepts at time t=0, irrespective of the layer.
When consolidating the results from all the
layers on the drill-down, each layer is offset.
For example if our basic model point (layer 0)
incepts at the valuation date, say 31/12/1996,
then for this layer at time t=0 cal_year=1996, at
time t=1 cal_year=1997 etc.
The second layer (known as layer 1) should
incept at 31/1/1997. During the run of layer 1,
31/1/1997 is taken to be t=0, however when
presented in the drill-down it is offset to t=1. In
consequence during the run of layer 1 cal_year
at time t=0 is 1997.

Description:
Calendar year in period t
Help:
The actual calendar year we are presently in at
time period t.
Note on New Business Layering:
When performing a run, new business always
incepts at time t=0, irrespective of the layer.
When consolidating the results from all the
layers on the drill-down, each layer is offset.
For example if our basic model point (layer 0)
incepts at the valuation date, say 31/12/1996,
then for this layer at time t=0 cal_year=1996, at
time t=1 cal_year=1997 etc.
The second layer (known as layer 1) should
incept at 31/1/1997. During the run of layer 1,
31/1/1997 is taken to be t=0, however when
presented in the drill-down it is offset to t=1. In
consequence during the run of layer 1 cal_year
at time t=0 is 1997.

Description:
Calendar year in period t
Help:
The actual calendar year we are presently in at
time period t.
Note on New Business Layering:
When performing a run, new business always
incepts at time t=0, irrespective of the layer.
When consolidating the results from all the
layers on the drill-down, each layer is offset.
For example if our basic model point (layer 0)
incepts at the valuation date, say 31/12/1996,
then for this layer at time t=0 cal_year=1996, at
time t=1 cal_year=1997 etc.
The second layer (known as layer 1) should
incept at 31/1/1997. During the run of layer 1,
31/1/1997 is taken to be t=0, however when
presented in the drill-down it is offset to t=1. In
consequence during the run of layer 1 cal_year
at time t=0 is 1997.
